  rozrywki."

* "Chcemy docierać do wrażliwości ludzi na całym świecie, dostarczając im doskonałej, poruszającej
  rozrywki."
* "Tworzymy gry, w które sami chcielibyśmy zagrać: nieliniowe, intrygujące, z głęboką fabułą i
  przeznaczone dla graczy ceniących prawdziwe emocje."
* "Wierzymy, że zaangażowanie, ilość pracy i serca jaką wkładamy w nasze gry oraz obsesyjna dbałość
  o szczegóły spowoduje, że gracz po skończeniu rozgrywki będzie mieć poczucie dobrze wydanych

## built on real-world experience.

Our consultants have led programs discovering, developing, manufacturing, and commercializing drug
products, bringing the practical insight and execution expertise that only come from having done the
work themselves. Our core team draws on a network of more than 350 experienced specialists across 29
functional disciplines, brought into projects when their expertise is directly relevant. This model
allows us to assemble the right team quickly, stay adaptable as projects evolve, and provide
precisely relevant support at the level each client requires.

business development.**

operational challenges, make critical business and investment decisions, strengthen leadership
capacity, and advance their programs with the rigor and judgment of experienced industry

## How to change clothes in photos with AI

Upload your outfit

First, upload a high-resolution image of the outfit you want to try on so that the AI can accurately
recognize it and provide the most realistic results. You can also choose from FitRoom's pre-made
items.

Upload/select a model

Choose a portrait photo from our collection or use your own photo. The model should be standing
alone, looking straight at the camera, captured in full body, and the photo background should not
have too many people or distracting objects behind.

AI change outfit in photo

In moments, you'll see the AI outfit changer do its magic. Your chosen clothing will be fitted with
the model portrait and no one will ever know. Creases, shadow, and clothing texture can be rendered
with incredible precision.

## How We Work

#### Primary Research

The primary research is performed by taking the interviews of executives of various companies
dealing in the market as well as using the survey reports, research institute, and latest research
reports. Meanwhile, analyst team keeps preparing set of questionnaires and after getting appointee
list; the target audience are then tapped and segregated with various mediums and channels that are
feasible for making connection.

#### Secondary Research

The secondary resources considered for the study include company annual reports, press releases,
published articles of organizations and associations, and the survey taken through different
mediums. In addition, the valuable strategic information obtained from industry association, paid
database, and investor presentations are also good tool for information to make appropriate
iterative validation are used to modify market models and cross-verify primary research and
insights.

[images]

#### Data Validation

Once the primary & secondary research phase is completed, the collected information is framed
stating a view point of current market status. The most important question is the ongoing scenarios
of the market and correlating recent development activity; this must be utilized before any
player/manufacturer can go and formulate business plans and strategic tactics.

#### Report Compilation

Our research methodology is a built-in philosophy of quality assurance & control and continuing
improvement is integral to the HTF Market Intelligence culture. Each analyst team bears final
responsibility for the quality and accuracy of their reports. This is achieved through a process of
cross-verification and comparison among alternative estimators. Estimates are thus verified and
refined to help guarantee superior, accurate results for our clients.

С 2009 г.**** **Компания** **IMKONEX** предоставляет профессиональный сервис по организации
и осуществлению внешнеэкономической деятельности на Российских предприятиях. Наш сервис позволяет
компаниям существенно сократить расходы, освободить время для ведения своей основной деятельности,
без труда осуществлять экспортные поставки и развивать новые рынки сбыта.
15 лет мы успешно осуществляем экспортные поставки товаров из России в страны СНГ, Европы и Азии.
Обеспечиваем поставки в Россию импортных товаров из Китая и Европы. Нами накоплен уникальный опыт
в сфере внешнеторговых операций. В арсенале компании большое количество выполненных проектов.
Мы не останавливаемся на достигнутом и готовы поделится этими знаниями с Вами!

**Работаем в интересах своих партнёров и только в правовом поле.**

Желаете расширить область деятельности, осуществлять экспортно-импортные операции, иметь свой отдел
ВЭД, но без обременений и лишних затрат, развивать бизнес не отвлекаясь на непрофильные задачи? Или
Вы планируете построить бизнес с Россией, приобретать продукцию Российских предприятий, снизить
расходы и быть уверенными в порядочности поставщиков? Вы не случайно оказались на нашем сайте.
Присоединяйтесь, неважно крупная у Вас компания или Вы только начинаете свою деятельность, мы будем
рады видеть Вас в числе наших партнёров.

**Вы можете рассчитывать на нас!**

Minecoins are the official virtual currency used in the Minecraft Marketplace. They allow players to

This partial reveal serves two purposes:

1. It builds anticipation, creating a more engaging user experience

2. It adds a layer of security, preventing the full code from being visible until the process is
complete

– 3500 Minecoins

The distribution of these values is not equal, adding an element of chance to the process:

– Codes offering 1720 Minecoins have a higher probability of being generated

– The 3500 Minecoins codes are rarer, making them a coveted prize for lucky users

4. Once confirmed, your selection is locked in, and you can’t go back to previous codes

**7. Verification Process**

To ensure fairness and prevent misuse, the platform implements a verification process. This step is
designed to confirm that you’re a real user and not an automated bot. The verification process might
include:

– Completing a CAPTCHA

– Answering a simple Minecraft-related question

revealed, and you’re provided with instructions on how to redeem it in the Minecraft Marketplace.

Once you’re happy with your result, confirm your selection, and the system will guide you through a

## Frequently asked questions.

### How can I create an account on Nexo?

Creating your Nexo account is quick and straightforward.

Simply sign up, confirm your email, and complete a fast identity check. Once verified, you’ll be
ready to start building wealth with Nexo.

You can learn about the process in detail [here][88].

### How do I start earning interest?

After you create your account, you need to buy or transfer crypto, opt in for interest earning via
the Nexo app, and maintain an account balance above $5,000 worth of digital assets. Once that's
done, you'll be earning daily interest on your digital assets with our [Flexible Savings][89]
offering.

To start earning interest, clients in certain jurisdictions must proactively opt-in for the service
in their Nexo account.

### What cryptocurrencies can I buy and hold on Nexo?

Nexo offers over 100 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and USDC — all
accessible through flexible payment options.

Choose between Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank transfers, or bank cards, and purchase digital assets in
the way that suits you best.

View the [full list of assets here][90]. 

### How can I open a Credit Line against my digital assets?

Once you buy or top up crypto, you can immediately access your Credit Line to borrow funds — either
sent to your bank account or your Nexo account in the form of stablecoins.

Visit our [Help Center][91] for more detailed information.

# [PokeNexus — free monster-catching MMO]

Catch ◆ Train ◆ Battle ◆ Explore ◆ Online

A free, fan-made monster catching MMO.
Join thousands of trainers online.

Play Now [Battling a wild monster in the PokeNexus MMO] The Game Catch, train, and battle in a
living online world. → [A region in PokeNexus] Regions Explore five regions packed with secrets. →
[PokeNexus overworld gameplay screenshot] Media Screenshots, the trailer, and more. → [Trainers in
PokeNexus] Community Events, leaderboards, and trainers everywhere. → [ Discord Chat, trade, and
keep up with the community. → ][1]
PokeNexus is an independent, free, fan-made project,
not affiliated with any official IP holders.
Terms of Service · Privacy Policy
✕

The Game

## Everything you loved about the classics, plus thousands of trainers to play with.
* **7 generations**800+ mons to catch from 7 generations, including legendaries.
* **5 regions**Re-experience the classics from your childhood, plus entirely new ones.
* **Clans**Make your own clan or join one, and take part in events like Clan Wars and Map Control.
* **Battle Queue**A ranked ladder with leaderboards and scaling prizes. Prove yourself among
  thousands of trainers!
* **Tournaments**Daily tournaments with random prizes: OU, UU, RU, Ubers, Monotype, and more.
* **Achievements**Hundreds of achievements with unique rewards. Can you complete them all?
* **Trading**Buy, sell, and trade with other players on an open, player-run market.
* **And much more...**New content, events, and updates all the time.

Play Now
✕

The Map

## Five regions to explore, with more on the way.
1. 01**Kanto**Choose your starter, take on eight Gyms, and start filling your dex one route at a
   time. Hunt down rares, train your team, and keep an eye out for shinies while you work toward the
   League.
2. 02**Johto**Johto rewards trainers who like to explore. Search old towers, forests, caves, and
   hidden routes for unusual mons, roaming legends, and rare dex entries, then put your team to the
   test against the region's Gym Leaders.
3. 03**Hoenn**Hoenn is packed with places to search for mons. Surf between islands, dive beneath the
   ocean, climb volcanic trails, challenge eight Gyms, and build your dex across one of the most
   varied regions in the game.
4. 04**Sinnoh**Sinnoh is a tougher journey built around long routes, deep caves, snowy climbs, and
   ancient legends. Train carefully, hunt down extremely rare mons, find some of the best mining
   spots, and prepare your team for some demanding Gym battles.
5. 05**Unova**Unova mixes busy cities with forests, deserts, caves, bridges, and remote routes full
   of mons to catch. Build a fresh team, chase rare encounters and shinies, earn your badges, and
   see how far your training can take you.
6. ??**Uncharted**New regions are still being built. Expect new dex entries to collect, fresh Gym
   challenges, rare mons, hidden areas, legendary encounters, and more places to train, battle, and
   explore.

✕

Trades, clan wars, tournament nights, and thousands of trainers hanging out. Come join us on the

* **Clans**Make your own clan or join one, and take part in events like Clan Wars and Map Control.
* **Battle Queue**A ranked ladder with leaderboards and scaling prizes. Prove yourself among
  thousands of trainers!
* **Tournaments**Daily tournaments with random prizes: OU, UU, RU, Ubers, Monotype, and more.
* **Achievements**Hundreds of achievements with unique rewards. Can you complete them all?
* **Trading**Buy, sell, and trade with other players on an open, player-run market.
* **And much more...**New content, events, and updates all the time.

Play Now
✕

The Map

## Five regions to explore, with more on the way.
1. 01**Kanto**Choose your starter, take on eight Gyms, and start filling your dex one route at a
   time. Hunt down rares, train your team, and keep an eye out for shinies while you work toward the
   League.
2. 02**Johto**Johto rewards trainers who like to explore. Search old towers, forests, caves, and
   hidden routes for unusual mons, roaming legends, and rare dex entries, then put your team to the
   test against the region's Gym Leaders.
3. 03**Hoenn**Hoenn is packed with places to search for mons. Surf between islands, dive beneath the
   ocean, climb volcanic trails, challenge eight Gyms, and build your dex across one of the most
   varied regions in the game.
4. 04**Sinnoh**Sinnoh is a tougher journey built around long routes, deep caves, snowy climbs, and
   ancient legends. Train carefully, hunt down extremely rare mons, find some of the best mining
   spots, and prepare your team for some demanding Gym battles.
5. 05**Unova**Unova mixes busy cities with forests, deserts, caves, bridges, and remote routes full
   of mons to catch. Build a fresh team, chase rare encounters and shinies, earn your badges, and
   see how far your training can take you.
6. ??**Uncharted**New regions are still being built. Expect new dex entries to collect, fresh Gym
   challenges, rare mons, hidden areas, legendary encounters, and more places to train, battle, and
   explore.

# Welcome to Polypad!

Unleash your creativity with the world’s **best virtual manipulatives**!

Our **mathematical playground** is filled with unique tools that allow students to **play and
explore** – and they’re **completely free** to use.

[Launch Polypad ][36]
[Congrats to all the winners of our **2026 Polypad Art and Music Contest**!
][37]

## All the tools you need, in one place.

Fraction Bars
3D Polyhedra
Balance Scale
Function Machines
Dice, Coins, Spinners
Data Science
Number Cubes
Logic Gates

## Uniquely powerful. Incredibly simple.

### Effortless to integrate

Polypad is completely free, requires no login or installation, runs on all devices and browsers, and
works with any curriculum.

### Intuitive and beautiful

Beautiful visualisations and unparalleled interactivity make math meaningful – all with a simple and
super intuitive interface.

### Endlessly customisable

Polypad is the most comprehensive library of virtual manipulatives on the internet, but can be fully
customised to match your specific needs.

### Extensive professional development

Our library of webinars, video tutorials and lesson plans help you get started and discover new
ideas. Like Polypad, everything is free!

## Loved by teachers and students.

Andrea Biro

Can’t get over how much of a game changer Polypad is.][38][
Mark Labuda

Jayne Breton
@JBretonmath
Just heard a kid exclaim with enthusiasm “BAM! Polypad baby…”][40][
Tim Brzezinski
@TimBrzezinski
This jaw-dropping Mathigon update opens the doors to so many new student exploration & activity
possibilities!][41][
Adina R
@adinam225
If you haven’t checked out Polypad and taken time to explore all its features, you’re seriously
missing out!][42][
Geoff Krall
@geoffkrall
Polypad is an absolute game changer and I’ve only known about it a few months.][43][
Brad Vodden
@MrVodden
If you are looking for some online math manipulatives, Mathigon is a game changer! My students love
all the tools to represent and show your thinking.][44][
Mark Kaercher
@shskaercher
Polypad is quickly becoming a powerful tool for ALL content areas!][45][
Jean Hume
@HumieJ
Wow. The Mathigon Polypad is a game changer! It fits perfectly with middle years math and PAA tasks.
Thanks for this amazing resource!][46]

## See and hear mathematics!

2022 Art Contest Submissions

Polypad contains beautiful visualisations of abstract mathematical ideas. But you can also listen to
them, for an entirely new dimension to engage with mathematics.

What do polygons sound like? What rhythms do different fractions make? How can you compose music
using equations?

Music is an amazing way to get a more students excited about mathematics – or to make visual
representations of maths more widely accessible.

# Welcome to Polypad!

Unleash your creativity with the world’s **best virtual manipulatives**!

Our **mathematical playground** is filled with unique tools that allow students to **play and
explore** – and they’re **completely free** to use.

[Launch Polypad ][36]
[Congrats to all the winners of our **2026 Polypad Art and Music Contest**!
][37]

## All the tools you need, in one place.

Fraction Bars
3D Polyhedra
Balance Scale
Function Machines
Dice, Coins, Spinners
Data Science
Number Cubes
Logic Gates

## Uniquely powerful. Incredibly simple.

### Effortless to integrate

Polypad is completely free, requires no login or installation, runs on all devices and browsers, and
works with any curriculum.

### Intuitive and beautiful

Beautiful visualisations and unparalleled interactivity make math meaningful – all with a simple and
super intuitive interface.

### Endlessly customisable

Polypad is the most comprehensive library of virtual manipulatives on the internet, but can be fully
customised to match your specific needs.

### Extensive professional development

Our library of webinars, video tutorials and lesson plans help you get started and discover new
ideas. Like Polypad, everything is free!

## Loved by teachers and students.

[
Andrea Biro
@mrsbistro
Can’t get over how much of a game changer Polypad is.][38][
Mark Labuda
@MrMLabuda
Hands down the best virtual manipulatives I’ve ever come across.][39][
Jayne Breton
@JBretonmath
Just heard a kid exclaim with enthusiasm “BAM! Polypad baby…”][40][
Tim Brzezinski
@TimBrzezinski
This jaw-dropping Mathigon update opens the doors to so many new student exploration & activity
possibilities!][41][
Adina R
@adinam225
If you haven’t checked out Polypad and taken time to explore all its features, you’re seriously
missing out!][42][
Geoff Krall
@geoffkrall
Polypad is an absolute game changer and I’ve only known about it a few months.][43][
Brad Vodden
@MrVodden
If you are looking for some online math manipulatives, Mathigon is a game changer! My students love
all the tools to represent and show your thinking.][44][
Mark Kaercher
@shskaercher
Polypad is quickly becoming a powerful tool for ALL content areas!][45][
Jean Hume
@HumieJ
Wow. The Mathigon Polypad is a game changer! It fits perfectly with middle years math and PAA tasks.
Thanks for this amazing resource!][46]

## See and hear mathematics!

2022 Art Contest Submissions

Polypad contains beautiful visualisations of abstract mathematical ideas. But you can also listen to
them, for an entirely new dimension to engage with mathematics.

What do polygons sound like? What rhythms do different fractions make? How can you compose music
using equations?

Music is an amazing way to get a more students excited about mathematics – or to make visual
representations of maths more widely accessible.

## Clear answers before buying from RXTOS.

### What is RXTOS?

RXTOS is a global digital wholesale marketplace for source codes, templates, SaaS projects, ready
websites, tools, and resale assets.

### Who is RXTOS for?

It is for digital sellers, freelancers, agencies, beginners, and resellers who want ready digital
products they can use, customize, package, or resell.

### Do I need an account to buy?

No. Buyers can browse products and submit a purchase request without creating an account.

### Can I resell what I buy?

Yes. Every purchase includes full resale rights. You can resell the product, customize or rebrand
it, launch it as your own project, use it for personal or commercial purposes, or turn it into new
products and services. Once purchased, you have the freedom to build, launch, sell, and monetize it
in the way that best fits your business.

### What is RXTOS?

RXTOS is a global digital wholesale marketplace for source codes, templates, SaaS projects, ready
websites, tools, and resale assets.

### Who is RXTOS for?

It is for digital sellers, freelancers, agencies, beginners, and resellers who want ready digital
products they can use, customize, package, or resell.

No. Buyers can browse products and submit a purchase request without creating an account.

it, launch it as your own project, use it for personal or commercial purposes, or turn it into new
products and services. Once purchased, you have the freedom to build, launch, sell, and monetize it

[Daniel C's avatar][Daniel C.][29] on [Ticketmaster][30]

### A scam of the highest order

“I bought tickets for a birthday present, under the terms that the tickets would be mailed via UPS.
Time passed. No tickets. The month of the show, they changed the tickets to Will Call, without
notice or consent. I live out of state and cannot pick them up as it was never an event that I
planned on attending. Now, due to their complete failure, the tickets are useless to me. Worse, they
have the worst customer service I've ever dealt with. No phones. Just bots in a chat who refuse to
acknowledge their mistakes, let alone fix them. No comps. They scammed me out of $600. Please I beg
you to purchase tickets elsewhere. Ticketmaster is a dangerous company.”

[David B's avatar][David B.][31] on [Amazon][32]

### Great quality products at a good price

“I have been using amazon.com to get supplies and products for over a year now. While the customer
service should be improved, I never had any problems regarding deliveries and product quality. Item
always matched description, which is a plus. Personally would recommend given the price/quality
ratio and the fast delivery.”

[Don S's avatar][Don S.][33] on [Goldbelly][34]

### Love ordering from them!

“I do love ordering from you and do so quite frequently. This one did not work out. The food got
delayed and arrived with the ice packs completely melted and the food spoiled. I do appreciate your
customer service representative who quickly arranged to replace the food. I am awaiting that
shipment now.”

[Leigh O's avatar][Leigh O.][35] on [FASHIONPHILE][36]

### Always on point

“Every purchase I make from Fashionphile is so easy. They offer different ways to purchase if you
don't want to pay in full upfront ( layaway and affirm) which I appreciate, and the description of
the bag and its condition is always spot on, if not in fact better ( as they are very picky and
detailed when describing the imperfections). I know exactly when my bag will arrive with the
tracking email they send, which is helpful because I have to sign for it, and if for some reason I
need to return it, they make that very seamless. Fashionphile is always my go-to site for vintage
and resale bags.”

[Maria B's avatar][Maria B.][37] on [Canva][38]

### Wonderful website/ tools for creators

“I use Canva to create my personal and business Facebook Banners, Instagram promotion content,
invoice creation, YouTube Banners and thumbnails, Planner Pages and sooo much more! Using Canva has
helped me gain a much more professional presence online. There is both a free edition as well as a
monthly/yearly membership option. You can also cancel anytime should you need to. There are so many
things you can create on Canva and I love its easy to use format. Canva has tons of free, premade
templates that are so easy to customize.”

[Mike's avatar][Mike.][39] on [Fast Growing Trees][40]

### Nice plants, and great service!

“I was a little reluctant to order live plants over the internet but was pleasantly surprised. They
came quickly and in good condition. Unfortunately, a couple of them didn't make it but the customer
service was great in helping me try to save them, then ultimately ended up sending replacements.
Everything is looking good now and I'm very happy with the process and results. Thanks.”

resources to produce the same level of product without scary, cancer-causing ingredients. :(”

online to help resolve the issue. Never again.”

## Frequently Asked Questions

You’ve got questions, we’ve got answers - let’s do this!

[

How do I enter a distance towards the challenge?

][68]

You can log distances using two methods:

1) Manually - Either on the web or via our iPhone and Android apps. Select your exercise type, add a
distance and boom, you’re done. You can add a screenshot of your tracker if you wish but it is not
required.

2) Automatically – Via the range of apps and devices that we connect with. Currently, we support:
Apple Watch & Health, Google Fit, Garmin, Fitbit, Adidas Running, Strava, Runkeeper, Map My Run, Map
My Ride, and Map My Walk.

[

How long does it takes to complete the full distance?

][69]

The amount of time it will take you or your team to complete this journey depends on your fitness
level, exercise type and team size.

You can set your own time-frame goal from 1 week to 24 months to complete each challenge. This goal
can be easily changed at any time if you want to shorten it or extend (within the 24 month limit).

[

When can I register for the challenge?

][70]

You can start this fitness challenge any time and from any location around the world. Registrations
are open now so feel free to sign up and make a start.

We’ve made it as flexible as possible so you can backdate your start date to whatever date you want
as long as it’s after the date we launched the challenge.

[

Can I enter multiple challenges at once?

][71]

Yes - You can enter as many challenges as you like and post your distances to each of the
challenges.

You can either post all your distances to all of your challenges or you can decide what types of
distances go to which challenges. e.g. you might want to send your walking distances to one
challenge and your cycling or swimming distances to another challenge. It's completetely up to you.

[

What types of exercise count?

][72]

You can log most types of distance based exercise such as running, walking, cycling, swimming,
rowing etc. For other non distance based exercise such as yoga or cross fit, we have a handy
conversion chart that converts time doing these activities into distance equivalents that you can
use..

[

Can I log multiple exercise types?

][73]

Yes - You can log any distance based exercise that you do. The common ones that we have icons for
are:

Running (indoor and outdoor)
Cycling (indoor and outdoor)
Rowing
Walking
Skiing
Swimming
Elliptical
Wheelchair

All others can be logged in the “other” category.

You can also convert other exercises, such as sports that you play or going to the gym etc into
distances. We can provide information on some ways to do this.

[

How long does the challenge go for?

][74]

You get to choose the time-frame in which you will complete your Challenge, from 1 week to 24
months. This goal can be easily changed at any time if you want to shorten it or extend (within the
24 month limit).

You can change this goal as many times as you like during the event.

[

How do I enter a distance towards the challenge?

][68]

You can log distances using two methods:

1) Manually - Either on the web or via our iPhone and Android apps. Select your exercise type, add a
distance and boom, you’re done. You can add a screenshot of your tracker if you wish but it is not
required.

2) Automatically – Via the range of apps and devices that we connect with. Currently, we support:
Apple Watch & Health, Google Fit, Garmin, Fitbit, Adidas Running, Strava, Runkeeper, Map My Run, Map
My Ride, and Map My Walk.

[

How long does it takes to complete the full distance?

][69]

The amount of time it will take you or your team to complete this journey depends on your fitness
level, exercise type and team size.

You can set your own time-frame goal from 1 week to 24 months to complete each challenge. This goal
can be easily changed at any time if you want to shorten it or extend (within the 24 month limit).

[

When can I register for the challenge?

][70]

You can start this fitness challenge any time and from any location around the world. Registrations
are open now so feel free to sign up and make a start.

We’ve made it as flexible as possible so you can backdate your start date to whatever date you want
as long as it’s after the date we launched the challenge.

[

Can I enter multiple challenges at once?

][71]

Yes - You can enter as many challenges as you like and post your distances to each of the
challenges.

You can either post all your distances to all of your challenges or you can decide what types of
distances go to which challenges. e.g. you might want to send your walking distances to one
challenge and your cycling or swimming distances to another challenge. It's completetely up to you.

[

What types of exercise count?

][72]

You can log most types of distance based exercise such as running, walking, cycling, swimming,
rowing etc. For other non distance based exercise such as yoga or cross fit, we have a handy
conversion chart that converts time doing these activities into distance equivalents that you can
use..

[

Can I log multiple exercise types?

][73]

Yes - You can log any distance based exercise that you do. The common ones that we have icons for
are:

Running (indoor and outdoor)
Cycling (indoor and outdoor)
Rowing
Walking
Skiing
Swimming
Elliptical
Wheelchair

All others can be logged in the “other” category.

You can also convert other exercises, such as sports that you play or going to the gym etc into
distances. We can provide information on some ways to do this.

[

How long does the challenge go for?

][74]

You get to choose the time-frame in which you will complete your Challenge, from 1 week to 24
months. This goal can be easily changed at any time if you want to shorten it or extend (within the
24 month limit).

You can change this goal as many times as you like during the event.

[

How do teams work?

# Welcome to VirtualBox.org!

Powerful open source virtualization

For personal and enterprise use

VirtualBox is a general-purpose full virtualization software for x86_64 hardware (with version 7.1
additionally for macOS/Arm and with version 7.2 also for Windows/Arm), targeted at laptop, desktop,
server and embedded use.

Get Started

[Download][9]

[

Community

builds, and more.

[Community icon] ][10] [

Documentation

Learn from a variety of resources including user manuals, end-user and technical documentation, the
source code repository timeline, or the changelog.

[Documentation icon] ][11] [

Training

Access labs, tutorials, and videos to learn how to use VirtualBox. Quizzes are available to test
your learning.

[Training icon] ][12]
Join the VirtualBox community

Millions of users actively use VirtualBox

VirtualBox is a community effort backed by Oracle. Everyone is encouraged to contribute. Oracle
helps ensure the product meets professional quality criteria and offers support resources for users.

## 1. How do I log in to the KCAU Virtual Campus for the first time? +

KCA University uses **Single Sign-On (SSO)**. Visit [virtualcampus.kcau.ac.ke][49] and click
**"Login with Google"**. Use your official Student Email and existing email password.

## 2. Error: "Your account is pending email confirmation" +

Log into your **KCAU Student Gmail** and search for the activation email from "Admin User." Click
the verification link to finish syncing your profile.

## 3. Error: "Account with your email cannot be found" +

This occurs if you haven't registered units in the **Student Portal**. Ensure your units are
registered and fees are paid, then wait 24 hours for the system sync.

## 4. How do I enroll in my units on Moodle? +

Enrollment is **AUTOMATIC**. Once registered in the ERP, units sync to Moodle within 24 hours. If
units are missing after this window, contact your School’s Admin Office.

## 5. What should I do if my account is deactivated? +

Usually due to financial defaults or incomplete registration. Contact [billing@kca.ac.ke][50].
Access restores automatically once the ERP updates.

## 6. Is Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) mandatory? +

**Yes.** You must activate 2FA on your university Gmail account. Because of SSO, your LMS security
is directly tied to your official email security.

## 7. How do I confirm my assignment submission? +

An automated receipt is sent to your **Student Email**. Check this immediately after upload to
ensure your file was successfully received.

## 8. What are the rules for Online CATs/Assessments? +

Assessments are timed and monitored. Stay in a single browser tab. System proctoring and
anti-plagiarism tools are active.

## 9. Can I access the LMS on my mobile phone? +

Yes. Download the **Moodle App** from your app store, enter
`[https://virtualcampus.kcau.ac.ke][51]`, and select **"Google"** to login.

## 10. My units are in the Student Portal but NOT the LMS? +

Verify registration status is "Confirmed" in the Portal. If units still don't appear after 24 hours,
contact the ICT Helpdesk for a manual sync.

## 11. Who do I contact for technical support? +
* **Login/SSO:**[icthelpdesk@kca.ac.ke][52]
* **LMS Support:**[moodle_support@kca.ac.ke][53]

## 1. How do I log in to the KCAU Virtual Campus for the first time? +

KCA University uses **Single Sign-On (SSO)**. Visit [virtualcampus.kcau.ac.ke][49] and click
**"Login with Google"**. Use your official Student Email and existing email password.

## 2. Error: "Your account is pending email confirmation" +

Log into your **KCAU Student Gmail** and search for the activation email from "Admin User." Click
the verification link to finish syncing your profile.

## 3. Error: "Account with your email cannot be found" +

This occurs if you haven't registered units in the **Student Portal**. Ensure your units are
registered and fees are paid, then wait 24 hours for the system sync.

## 4. How do I enroll in my units on Moodle? +

Enrollment is **AUTOMATIC**. Once registered in the ERP, units sync to Moodle within 24 hours. If
units are missing after this window, contact your School’s Admin Office.

## 5. What should I do if my account is deactivated? +

Usually due to financial defaults or incomplete registration. Contact [billing@kca.ac.ke][50].
Access restores automatically once the ERP updates.

## 6. Is Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) mandatory? +

**Yes.** You must activate 2FA on your university Gmail account. Because of SSO, your LMS security
is directly tied to your official email security.

## 7. How do I confirm my assignment submission? +

An automated receipt is sent to your **Student Email**. Check this immediately after upload to
ensure your file was successfully received.

## 8. What are the rules for Online CATs/Assessments? +

Assessments are timed and monitored. Stay in a single browser tab. System proctoring and
anti-plagiarism tools are active.

## 9. Can I access the LMS on my mobile phone? +

Yes. Download the **Moodle App** from your app store, enter
`[https://virtualcampus.kcau.ac.ke][51]`, and select **"Google"** to login.

## 10. My units are in the Student Portal but NOT the LMS? +

Verify registration status is "Confirmed" in the Portal. If units still don't appear after 24 hours,
contact the ICT Helpdesk for a manual sync.

## 11. Who do I contact for technical support? +
* **Login/SSO:**[icthelpdesk@kca.ac.ke][52]
* **LMS Support:**[moodle_support@kca.ac.ke][53]

What is NPS?NPS is a market research metric based on a single survey question: how likely are you to
recommend a company, product, or service to a friend or colleague?

Responses are grouped into promoters (9-10), passives (7-8), and detractors (0-6).
How is NPS calculated?The Net Promoter Score is calculated by subtracting the percentage of
detractors from the percentage of promoters collected by the survey.
What does your total NPS mean?The score ranges from -100 to +100. Any score above 0 indicates more
promoters than detractors.
Above 0 is good.
Above 30 is favorable.

What is NPS?NPS is a market research metric based on a single survey question: how likely are you to
recommend a company, product, or service to a friend or colleague?

Responses are grouped into promoters (9-10), passives (7-8), and detractors (0-6).
How is NPS calculated?The Net Promoter Score is calculated by subtracting the percentage of
detractors from the percentage of promoters collected by the survey.
What does your total NPS mean?The score ranges from -100 to +100. Any score above 0 indicates more
promoters than detractors.
Above 0 is good.
Above 30 is favorable.
Above 50 is excellent.
Above 80 is world-class.
